task: Compare three AI models for a support chatbot handling 10,000 requests per month under a $50/month budget, using these VERIFIED official prices from Groq's documentation (https://console.groq.com/docs/models, retrieved 2026-11-11), per 1M tokens input/output: openai/gpt-oss-20b $0.075/$0.30, openai/gpt-oss-120b $0.15/$0.60, qwen/qwen3.8-27b (preview) $0.80/$4.00. Treat these rates as immutable inputs - do NOT re-derive prices from search text. Use ONE web search only to confirm the official Groq pricing page currently lists these models (validation of the source, not price extraction). Then compute each model's monthly cost with a Python node assuming 800 input tokens and 300 output tokens per request, printing one JSON object. Finally write a recommendation citing the computed numbers and the source URL.
